name: engineering-practices
description: Durable defaults for every session: understand before you change, leave the code smaller than you found it, reuse before adding, ship small increments, work test-driven, be correct by construction, say less in the code. A SessionStart hook that states the contract, a Stop hook that measures the change against it, and eight skills covering the work around the code - framing it, reviewing your own diff, shipping the PR, auditing the repo.
